item1.question: Is this template free?
item1.answer: Yes. It is a free NextJS Shadcn template.

item2.question: Can I use this template for commercial projects?
item2.answer: Absolutely. This template is released under the MIT license, so you can freely use it for both personal and commercial projects at no extra cost.

item3.question: How do I customize the colors and styles?
item3.answer: You can customize colors, fonts, and other styles through the Tailwind CSS v4 theme tokens and CSS variables in app/globals.css.

item4.question: Which browsers are supported?
item4.answer: The starter targets current evergreen browsers. Test the exact browser and device matrix your audience requires before release.

item5.question: How do I get technical support?
item5.answer: Report reproducible bugs through GitHub Issues, or start a question in GitHub Discussions.
